An element overlapping the variant is not established because no ENCODE cCRE overlaps it.
CYP7A1 is only a distant candidate by proximity; no evidence here links this variant to CYP7A1 regulation, and no significant GTEx eQTL was reported.

A downstream LDL effect is hypothetical; the supplied variant and CYP7A1 lookups do not establish an LDL association.
